name: 33009 · Hallandle Bch, FL
findings: ZIP 33009 (Hallandle Bch) has 127 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33009 (Hallandle Bch) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
51% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
